stem: A technician correctly recognizes why a pump has failed but has not been trained or authorized to service it. What demonstrates competence?
choices: Document the observed condition and escalate within the defined role boundary
Repair it because the likely cause is known
Ask a coworker to watch while attempting the repair
Keep resetting it until it runs
rationale: Knowing a likely cause does not create servicing authorization. Technician I competence includes accurate observation, safe boundaries, and useful escalation.
